notes.text: Yochanan’s title is abbreviated and retained as R'; Tanna is explicit but does not establish a full personal rank. Heading גודגדא and body גודגדה remain distinct Hebrew forms under the inherited Gudgada transliteration. 3a follows the period convention without a named-edition check. The older note’s word printed describes the supplied digital locator only; no printed page was inspected.
